test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Anuj started to walk from a point A and goes 10 m towards North and then turned left and walked 5 m. He then turned right and walked a distance of 5 m and then again turned right and walked a distance of 5 m before stopping at point P. How far and towards which direction should he walk in order to reach Point A starting from Point P?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given: 

Anuj started to walk from a point A and goes 10 m towards North,

And then turned left and walked 5 m.

He then turned right and walked a distance of 5 m,

And then again turned right and walked a distance of 5 m before stopping at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e0cdc3555dffa194e35a2589fa8b17494e8905755864aa972c2aa85bf833c3f.png] 

So, Point A is '**15 m towards South**' from Point P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
